title: Case 005: Recipient asks for an authorised household member to receive the parcel

details.data: Entirely synthetic; English; fictional geography; all times UTC

context: A standard parcel permits a nominated adult household receiver under the carrier’s fictional service rules. No restricted or identity-specific goods are involved.
initial_request: I need to step out during the window. Could my adult brother receive this parcel instead? I have not added his name to the booking.
overview: The escalation snapshot comprises history events 001–002. Event 003 records the next agent action; the subsequent events provide the disclosed calibration follow-through. Facts learned later must not be used as if already known at escalation.

next_action.summary: Ask the recipient to nominate a receiver under the operator's stated service conditions.

outcome: Dispatch confirms the approved receiver is recorded; handover remains pending.
boundaries: This policy is limited to the stated ordinary parcel; nomination is not delivery.

events.body: DL-005 uses our ordinary household parcel service. A verified recipient may nominate an adult household member by name in the order portal. Nomination must be recorded before the route is released.
I need to step out during the window. Could my adult brother receive this parcel instead? I have not added his name to the booking.
Please confirm the name of the adult household member you authorise to receive DL-005. Our recipient services team will record the nomination under this parcel’s service rules.
I nominate my adult brother, Halen Venn, to receive DL-005 at my delivery address. This is just for this shipment.
Following your submission of the verified portal nomination, Halen Venn is the approved alternate receiver for DL-005. The route record is updated; handover is pending.
